prompts.attack:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one production animation sprite atlas for LUCIEN from the attached approved idle atlas, which is the immutable identity and clean anime sprite style reference. SAME person in every frame: elegant adult pale man, long silver hair tied loosely low, grey eyes, dark petrol-blue long split coat, burgundy lining, black high-collar tunic, grey trousers, black boots, ONE silver pauldron on anatomical RIGHT shoulder, restrained silver leaf hem ornament and silver fastenings. RIGHT gloved hand ALWAYS grips the dark hilt of ONE straight silver sword with wing-shaped guard and teal gem. LEFT hand empty with bare fingers. No weapon swapping, no extra sword, no extra limbs, no gloves changing colors. Correct fingers behind crossguard; straight blade attached properly to hilt, never reversed. Face predominantly RIGHT-FACING profile, eyes watching enemy to screen-right, not the viewer. Same slender athletic proportions and long normal legs; no short torso or giant head. Crisp hand-drawn anime cel shading matching the supplied existing sprites; do not make painterly/3D/pixel art. Full hair, both boots and entire sword inside each cell, no overlap between drawings. REAL alpha transparent background; NO glows, shadows, FX, backgrounds, borders, numbers, text or opponents. Each frame is a genuinely different drawing of the specified action, consistent costume and sword dimensions. Atlas layout: square 1536x1536, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, six wide 768x512 cells in reading order. Normal standing anatomical height 430px, same body scale in every cell, allow crouched poses to naturally be shorter. Feet normally rest at y=485 relative to each cell; 20+px transparent clearance from every edge. Use wide cells to fit the entire sword.
Action: ONE elegant lateral sword attack with full-body weight transfer, NOT an overhead chop and NOT just stretching an arm.
1: right-facing low guard matching idle, knees soften, right hand starts drawing sword inward beside right hip, left hand open for balance.
2: loaded anticipation, weight on rear leg, shoulders and hips coil slightly, right elbow bends drawing hilt beside right ribs, blade angles back beside body. Face still watches enemy right.
3: contact, committed step with front foot toward RIGHT, hips and shoulders unwind, torso inclines forward, right arm extends into a low sweeping forward cut toward screen-right. Silver blade approximately horizontal at opponent waist height, tip clear to the RIGHT. Left hand balances behind torso, visibly empty. Actual whole-body lunge, not stationary legs.
4: follow-through, front knee flexed and rear heel lifted, hips finish turn, right hand continues the cut across front, blade now diagonally down-right, hair and coat sweep behind movement.
5: recover upright while retracting sword arm, draw front foot back towards starting stance; blade lowers into low guard.
6: return to the EXACT right-facing idle pose and footprint from reference, sword lowered diagonally right, left hand empty. No special effects drawn; an independent game effect will follow the blade.
